kernel: step.c v11 (VERSION 6): u = mix(K_lo ^ kappa_b) selects the slot; restart and escape exponents e = PRF(message) applied by the comb of g.
measurement_tool: organizer image, measure.sh (blst f7a88067, GCC 14.2.0, Valgrind 3.24.0 Callgrind Ir); N1=256/N2=512, MODE 4096/8192
method: Forced all-adder (S=0) and all-square (S=1024) inputs at DP_BITS 60; per-step = Callgrind difference over 64 walks (analyze.py). Restart, PRF and DP record measured alone (restartbench, prfbench, storebench).

reference_unit.REF_INST_method: REF_FUNCS=ref_mul toggle pass on seed-1 production inputs, (ref-512 - ref-256) / (adds-512 - adds-256)
reference_unit.charged: 1 unit (the organizer's reference operation; the adder calls it)

restart_instructions.measurement: restartbench (Ir(8192)-Ir(4096))/4096: PRF, comb, a+e, key, clear
restart_instructions.charged: one restart; the spec charges 32 comb multiplications plus PRF_INST (section 8)

restart_multiplications.measurement: comb multiplications per restart = nonzero bytes of e, from restartbench stderr (comb_mults / 8192)

prf_instructions.measurement: prfbench: one restart PRF (two SHA-256 blocks, reduction mod r)

comb_table.note: built once at load from the generator g (input block 'gen'); load is outside the callgrind window

distinguished_point_record_instructions.measurement: mode storebench: (Ir(8192) - Ir(4096)) / 4096 for one record (fingerprint and two canonical exponents)

sort_compare_exchange_instructions.measurement: carried from RESULT-v10.json: mode sortbench (code unchanged in v11, not re-measured)

anchor_cost.note: Included in the per-step counts (anchor compare each step, refresh every 64 rounds).

charged.restart_rule: v11: t++ then e=PRF(0x01||w||t), x*=g^e, a+=e, clear detector, AGE=0; escape: e=PRF(0x02||K_s), x=c_s*g^e, a=A_s+e, no AGE reset.

native_counts: native-counts-v11.json (uninstrumented, production DP_BITS = 60, 2^20 rounds per seed)
deviations: Restart table removed; exponents by PRF and comb of g (VERSION 6 input).
Trail age counts every non-DP main step, including the detecting step; cap check precedes the detector; escape keeps age.
K_s = 48-byte big-endian Montgomery integer of the key (spec leaves the representation open).
Restart cost uses the nonzero bytes of e (31.87 on average); comb build 8128 mults + 248 squarings.
sortbench removed from the package step.c; sort exchange value carried from RESULT-v10 (code unchanged).
